name: phone-management-blank-skills
text:

Roll = Skill Rank + Trait Rank, Keep = Trait Rank (adjust manually for High/Low or trait-only rolls). Scorpion Instigator

Advanced School · Scorpion · Courtier

CORE RULEBOOK PP.249-250

Clan
Scorpion
Type
Courtier
Requirements
Awareness 5; Intelligence 5; Perception 3; Courtier 6; Etiquette 5; Sincerity 5; Stealth 4; Blackmail (Advantage); Dark Secret (Disadvantage)
Also required
I disclosed at least one of my Dark Secrets to the Instigator sensei on joining.
Techniques
Rank 1: The Depths of Dishonor
On a contested Social Skill roll, gain extra unkept dice equal to the difference between your Honor Rank and your opponent's Honor Rank.
CORE RULEBOOK P.250
Rank 2: Sheath Your Lies in Truth
When a contested Social Skill roll determines whether someone detects your lie, spend 1 Void Point for +3k3 instead of the usual +1k1. Obviously false claims can still damage your reputation.
CORE RULEBOOK P.250
Rank 3: Pull the String
Converse with a Blackmail subject for 10 minutes, then spend 1 Void Point as a Complex Action and win Courtier (Manipulation) / Awareness against their Etiquette (Courtesy) / Willpower. Suggest an action that is neither life-threatening nor worse in consequence than disclosure. They must carry it out or lose 4 Honor points.
